title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass
summary: The improved Spyglass tool is now officially out of beta and fully available, providing all users with powerful new capabilities and a refined experience.

title: Advanced File Management & Display Options
summary: Our enhanced editor now provides comprehensive tools for effortless file management, enabling you to easily add, organize, and customize the visual presentation of all your files.

title: Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page provides a transparent and engaging way to follow our journey, showcasing completed features, upcoming additions, and long-term plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and visually appealing experience with redesigned checkboxes that are now easier to click and effortlessly draggable.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly improved the real-time editing experience, making it easier and more intuitive to collaborate seamlessly with your team.

title: Unlock Seamless Sharing: Enhanced Item Discovery
summary: Discover and collaborate on shared content effortlessly, as all relevant items from your network now appear directly in your search results.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: We are thrilled to introduce comprehensive international language support, enabling users worldwide to experience Noeko seamlessly in their native tongue.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement in development, and complete transparency into our progress.

title: Intelligent Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with powerful new filters for tags and time, alongside effortless visibility into all your shared items and collaborators, making your knowledge map an indispensable tool for discovery.

title: Enhanced Search & Personalized Compendiums
summary: Effortlessly refine your knowledge exploration with powerful new filtering and sorting capabilities, allowing you to save customized searches as dynamic Compendiums for instant access.

title: Enhanced Content Views
summary: This feature introduces flexible new ways to display and interact with your linked content, helping you structure your thoughts more intuitively and effectively.

title: Unlock Noeko's Potential: Self-Hosted & Premium Editions
summary: Experience enhanced flexibility and control with Noeko's new self-hosting capabilities and a range of premium plans tailored for every user, from individuals to large enterprises.

title: Stunning New Themes & Visual Upgrades
summary: Transform your workspace with a beautiful collection of enhanced existing themes and exciting new stylistic choices, offering a more personalized and engaging experience.

title: Smarter Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more accurate and delightful welcome with greetings that precisely match the time of your visit.

title: Direct Tag Item Control
summary: Gain immediate control over your tagged content with direct actions to effortlessly remove items from a tag or perform other quick management tasks, all without leaving your current view.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to seamlessly integrate and analyze content from popular sources like YouTube videos, websites, and text documents, empowering you with a more comprehensive view of your research.
